card.name: Linking words in Alabama place descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas (of, on, comma) right before a place name in text about Alabama and the Mobile area, or in lists of towns and places.

modes.label: Of before Alabama sites
modes.description: The word 'of' after a direction or place noun, just before an Alabama landmark.

modes.description: A comma after a town or birthplace, before the next place or date.
